evals.prompt: Upgrade our web app from framework v4 to v6. We use two plugins pinned to v4 peers and one removed router API.
evals.expected_output: A staged cross-major plan based on official migration evidence and real plugin compatibility.
expectations: Inventories actual usages and peer dependencies
Accounts for every crossed major version

evals.prompt: Bump a patch-level test-only dependency with no runtime imports.
evals.expected_output: A proportionate, narrow upgrade without unrelated migration work.
expectations: Confirms package identity and current usage
Preserves the package manager and lockfile

evals.prompt: npm suggests --force because the target package's peer range excludes our runtime framework. Apply it so install passes.
evals.expected_output: A stop or compatibility investigation rather than forcing an invalid graph.
expectations: Does not use force as the first resolution
Looks for a compatible target or plugin version

evals.prompt: Upgrade this package using a random migration blog; the official release notes are unavailable.
evals.expected_output: A cautious stop or explicitly constrained plan that does not treat the blog as authoritative.
expectations: Seeks primary package metadata or source history
Does not claim a safe completed migration
